Mercury outboard repair and service in Tampa Bay

Mercury's FourStroke and Pro XS engines dominate the bay-boat and flats-boat fleet, and Verados power a lot of the offshore center consoles. Mercury-certified mechanics in the network handle routine service through supercharger work.

Models we see most

FourStroke 40 to 150, Pro XS, Verado 200 to 400, SeaPro, older OptiMax and two-strokes

Service intervals

100 hours or annually. Verado supercharger oil at 300 hours; gearcase lube annually; water pump at 300 hours or 3 years. OptiMax air compressors have their own service schedule.

Parts and diagnostics

Parts are easy to source; the regional Mercury dealers are numerous. Mercury's CDS G3 diagnostics read Verado and SmartCraft data.

What goes wrong on Mercurys around here

  • Verado supercharger and belt service neglected: loss of top-end power
  • Pro XS and FourStroke fuel pump and VST issues from ethanol
  • Low oil pressure alarms at idle on high-hour Verados
  • OptiMax air compressor failures and injector issues
  • Trim limit and position sensors
  • SmartCraft gauge and harness faults

Questions we get

My Verado lost top end. Supercharger?

Often. Supercharger oil, belt, and intercooler cleaning restore it if the bearings are still good. Catch it early.

Do you work on older two-stroke Mercurys?

Yes, carbureted and EFI two-strokes; parts for some OptiMax models are getting scarce.
